2017.why: It drew less than a sixth as many complaints as the average car in its first 3 years.
2017.pln: less than a sixth as many complaints as the average car

2018.pln: complaints only, too few sold to score
td: Airbags
The airbag light should come on at start, then go out and stay out.
Brakes
Brake firmly once at speed: it should stop straight, with no pulsing, grinding or brake warning light.
Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Wheels
Look for bent or cracked wheels and listen for a hum or wobble at speed.

2019.pln: complaints only, too few sold to score
td: Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Fuel system
Watch for hard starts, stalling, hesitation or a fuel smell.
Auto braking
Watch for sudden braking or collision warnings with nothing ahead.
Engine
Start it cold if you can. Listen for ticking or knocking, and watch for smoke, a rough idle or a check-engine light.
Speed control
It should accelerate and hold speed smoothly, with no surging; try the cruise control.

2020.why: It drew about twice the average car's complaints in its first 3 years, most about engine. 2020 is one of the weaker years of a model that usually draws about two-thirds as many complaints as the average car.
2020.pln: about twice the average car's complaints
